evidence.quote: Duur 4 jaar, voltijd bachelor Taal Nederlands
Students with a non-EEA nationality are required to apply by May 1st and to pay their tuition fees in full prior to the start of the academic year.
Meld je aan voor de opleiding via Studielink.

notes: The programme page is in Dutch and describes this specific ICT bachelor (taught in Dutch, 4 years). The tuition figure (EUR 10,308 for non-EEA students, 2026-2027) and the May 1 application deadline come from Avans' central tuition-fees page and are stated for bachelor's/master's students generally, not for this programme alone; they are the only non-EU figures found and are used here, but should be confirmed. No document list for international applicants is given on the supplied pages.

note.en: A Moroccan Baccalauréat is not listed among the admitted diplomas. Contact Student Support / the instroomcoördinator to check your eligibility.
